{{Top|leg}}
The '''Adopt A Bantha Foundation''' was a program run by the [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] [[Priest/Legends|priests]]. For a donation of ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], individuals could "adopt" a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. They would receive regular [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] and monthly updates.<ref name="VI">{{WEGCite|story=Vested Interest|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set}}</ref>
